Proposition
[hat tensor of a $1$-form]

Source: petersen:page-0368, petersen:page-0369 ↗ lem:pet-ch9-ric-curvature-operator-hat-formula ↗ def:pet-ch9-tensor-lambda2-valued 1. ch9:9.4.10For a one-form $\omega =X^\flat $, \[ \hat\omega (Z)=X\wedge Z, \qquad g(\mathfrak R(\hat\omega ),\hat\omega )=\operatorname {Ric}(X,X). \]
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch9-1form-hat-ricci \sketch For skew $L$, $(L\omega )(Z)=-g(X,LZ)=g(L,X\wedge Z)$, hence $\hat\omega (Z)=X\wedge Z$. Applying subsection 4.5 and tracing over an orthonormal frame gives $g(\mathfrak R(\hat\omega ),\hat\omega )= \sum _iR(X,E_i,E_i,X)=\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)$.

□
